name: Tour and help
description: Shows how an extension brings its own guided tour and help articles, with a page and a card in Settings for the tour to point at.

tours.title: What an extension can show you

steps.title: A tour from an extension
steps.text: Extensions can bring their own guided tours. This one shows the places where this sample appears in GameScrcpy.

steps.title: Its card
steps.text: Every extension has a card on the Extensions page. Its Details lists the extension's tours, so you can play this one again.

steps.title: Its page
steps.text: The sample adds this page to the left column. Its app script draws it with GameScrcpy's own controls.

steps.title: Its settings
steps.text: A panel can also be a card in Settings. This one decides whether the sample's page shows a tip.

steps.title: Its help
steps.text: Press F1: the Extensions group of the help page holds the sample's articles, which can start this tour again too.

zh_CN.name: 引导与帮助示例
zh_CN.description: 演示扩展怎样自带功能引导和帮助文章，还带一个页面和设置里的一张卡片，给引导指着看。
zh_CN.panels.welcome.title: 引导示例
zh_CN.panels.options.title: 引导示例
zh_CN.tours.intro.title: 扩展能给你看什么
zh_CN.tours.intro.0.title: 扩展自带的引导
zh_CN.tours.intro.0.text: 扩展可以自带功能引导。这一段带你看这个示例在 GameScrcpy 里出现的几个地方。
zh_CN.tours.intro.1.title: 它的卡片
zh_CN.tours.intro.1.text: 每个扩展在扩展页都有一张卡片。“详情”里列出它的引导，可以从那里再放一遍。
zh_CN.tours.intro.2.title: 它的页面
zh_CN.tours.intro.2.text: 这个示例在左栏加了这一页，由它的应用脚本用 GameScrcpy 自己的控件画出来。
zh_CN.tours.intro.3.title: 它的设置
zh_CN.tours.intro.3.text: 面板也可以是设置里的一张卡片。这一张决定示例的页面上显示不显示提示。
zh_CN.tours.intro.4.title: 它的帮助
zh_CN.tours.intro.4.text: 按 F1：帮助页的“扩展”一组里有这个示例的文章，文章里也能重新开始这段引导。
zh_CN.help.guide.title: 引导与帮助示例
zh_CN.help.writing.title: 给扩展写帮助
